name: Goan Peri-Peri Wings
classification_note: Overlaps approved pool item #4 (Hefe-brined Wings) in format; differs in sauce. Not a replacement; proposed as a sauce variant.
cooking_method: Dry-brine wings, fry in two stages to 74 °C, toss in peri-peri sauce

portion.construction: wings tossed in sauce, crema on the side

steps: Dry-brine wings 2-12 h at ≤ 4 °C; pat dry; dust with cornflour just before frying.
Fry at about 175 °C 9-11 min until deep golden; probe to 74 °C.
Toss in warm peri-peri sauce; plate with crema, onion and lime.

plating: Black stoneware plate, wings piled, crema pool at the edge, lime wedge.
food_safety: Cook wings to 74 °C (165 °F), probed in the thickest piece.
Raw-protein board/utensils separated; hand-wash; marinate at ≤ 4 °C, discard marinade.
Hot-hold ≥ 57 °C (135 °F) or discard within 2 hours (policy to be set by a food-safety professional).
